title: UI change

title: Failed checks
why: Each failure's screenshot shows what broke before anyone reads the assertion

title: Setup flow

title: CI run

title: Disk

title: Share

title: CI time

title: Request flow
why: Branches are hard to follow in a list, and the drawing tints each decision and store by shape
